def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    rows = [r for r in range(h)
            if sum(v != background for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w)
            if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            line.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != background and
                        all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else 0)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = [
        r for r in range(h)
        if sum(v != background for v in grid[r]) > w / 2
    ]
    col_lines = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h)) > h / 2
    ]

    line_values = [
        grid[r][c]
        for r in row_lines for c in range(w)
        if grid[r][c] != background
    ] + [
        grid[r][c]
        for c in col_lines for r in range(h)
        if grid[r][c] != background
    ]
    separator = Counter(line_values).most_common(1)[0][0]

    marked = [
        (r, c) for r in row_lines for c in col_lines
        if grid[r][c] != separator
    ]
    if not marked:
        return []

    used_rows = [r for r in row_lines
                 if min(r0 for r0, _ in marked) <= r <= max(r0 for r0, _ in marked)]
    used_cols = [c for c in col_lines
                 if min(c0 for _, c0 in marked) <= c <= max(c0 for _, c0 in marked)]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(used_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(used_cols) - 1):
            r1, r2 = used_rows[i], used_rows[i + 1]
            c1, c2 = used_cols[j], used_cols[j + 1]
            corners = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2],
                       grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            row.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners)
                       else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
